subject: FinHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: FinHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through FinHealth's use case. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please correct anything I missed.

Pain points / goals
- Regulated PHI workloads: must ensure no egress of patient data to shared tenants and keep all inference processing inside a customer-managed VPC or on-prem.
- KMS/HSM requirement: customer-managed key for model inputs/outputs and auditable key-rotation policies.
- Air-gap consideration for certain environments (audit teams may require an offline image + manual patching).
- Latency SLA: 200ms p50 for inference on short prompts (customer expectation for triage workflows).

Current stack / constraints
- Primary infra: AWS GovCloud / us-east-2 for production.
- Identity: Okta SSO + SCIM for user provisioning.
- Network: strict egress rules; only allow outbound to specific IPs and AWS S3 endpoints via VPC endpoints.
- Security reviewers will require SOC2 evidence and a network diagram for the private deployment.

Success criteria for POC
1) Private (VPC) deployment that uses FinHealth-managed KMS and sits inside their VPC; no data leaves the VPC.
2) Demonstrated latency within 200ms p50 for your 100QPS baseline during a 30-minute test window.
3) Completed security questionnaire + network diagram for your auditors.

Next steps
- I'll send the security questionnaire and our private deployment checklist (attached). [Attachment: security_questionnaire.pdf]
- You to share the network diagram and any specific egress IP allowlist requirements by EOD next Wednesday (2026-06-23).
- Schedule a technical deep dive with our infra engineer (Aditya) — propose Wed 6/24 or Thu 6/25.

Attachments: security_questionnaire.pdf, redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on another call to clarify.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@finhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap and next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. Looks right to me. A few clarifications / additions from our side:

- KMS: we need to use our AWS KMS CMK (multi-tenant HSM not allowed). Can Redwood's agent accept an externally managed CMK via key-arn and use it for envelope encryption?
- Air-gap: for our most sensitive environment (Prod-PHI), the security team will want an air-gap option. That likely means an appliance image we can import into our private subnet and run without outbound internet. Can you confirm Redwood supports an entirely offline runtime image and documented manual patch process?
- Audit logs: we need per-request audit trail (request id, timestamp, user) exported to our CloudWatch Logs or to an S3 bucket we manage.

We'll gather and share the network diagram by 2026-06-23. Also looping in Lisa (security) who will own the questionnaire.

Appreciate you coordinating — Alex

---
Alex Johnson
Head of Data Engineering, FinHealth
alex.johnson@finhealth.com | (617) 555-2099
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinHealth - Private/VPC discovery recap and next steps (internal)

Marissa —

Noted. A few technical notes for the deep dive we should prepare:
- KMS: we support using a customer-provided CMK via AWS KMS key-arn and perform envelope encryption; need to confirm allowed key policies for cross-account use. Will draft a one-pager on the flow.
- Air-gap: we have an air-gapped runtime image (OCI tarball) used by two regulated customers; it requires manual onboarding of dependencies and our offline patch bundles. Need to align on support model (self-managed vs. Redwood-assisted).
- Network: we'll need the exact egress allowlist and whether FinHealth will provide NAT + VPC endpoints for S3. If they are fully offline for prod, we'll run KV/cache locally and disable external telemetry.
- Performance: to meet 200ms p50 at 100QPS we'll propose a dedicated GPU pool (A10G / similar) and a small scale test with representative payloads.

I'll be available for the technical deep dive on 6/24 at 10:00am PT. Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite.

- Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

If that looks right, I'll follow up with the attachments and calendar invite.
